pois.label: 三色警报柱 · 红警即回舱
pois.label_en: Three-colour alarm mast: red means go now
pois.detail: 演习的 t=0 是这根柱子转红的那一刻。全城地表 SEP 事件态只有一个判据源——地表辐射站(sci-rad-01)的 1 分钟滑动计数:≥3× 平静为黄,>30× 为红(红警三动作:EVA 回舱、直升机停飞、发射冻结)。本册独立复现了预警链的四个时刻:多 GeV 首批 17.0 min 到、166 MeV 截止能 32.2 min 补齐、EPS 100 MeV 前锋 39.6 min、10 MeV 117.1 min——地面对自己的剂量没有任何提前量,EPS 那一级相对地面剂量起始是 −7 到 −23 min,唯一的正提前量是 L4 日冕仪的 1–3 天结构预报。
pois.detail_en: t = 0 of the drill is the moment this mast turns red. The city has one criterion source for a surface SEP event state: the surface radiation station's 1-minute sliding count, yellow at 3x quiet, red above 30x (red actions: EVA return, helicopter grounded, launch window frozen). This ledger re-derived the four clocks of the warning chain: multi-GeV first arrivals at 17.0 min, the 166 MeV cutoff energy complete at 32.2 min, the EPS 100 MeV front at 39.6 min, 10 MeV at 117.1 min. The ground has no lead over its own dose; the orbital EPS tier sits 7 to 23 min behind the surface dose onset; the only positive lead is the L4 coronagraph's 1-3 day structural forecast.

specs.正提前量: 仅 L4 日冕仪 1–3 天(预报,命中率本册不评)

specs_en.EPS vs surface onset: -22.7 / -11.8 / -7.4 min (first / 245 MeV bulk / 166 MeV full band)
specs_en.Sentinel confirmation: perimeter column 5 sigma: F=2 188 s, F=10 8.5 s, 2017-class 35-188 s
specs_en.Positive lead: L4 coronagraph only, 1-3 d (forecast; hit rate not evaluated here)

sim: 预警时间账(mars-drill ledger/02_warning.py,6 闸全绿):相对论速度弥散,L=2.04 AU 帕克线,复现 sci-rad-01 账 5 的 17.0/32.2/39.6/117.1 min 与 77.5 min 窗口(<1%);哨兵 188/8 s 只有用「本底扣除差值方差」形式 (F−1)rT/√((F+1)rT)=5 才复现,本底-only 形式给 62/3 s——登记以免下一位读者去「更正」卡。
不对称结论:能排除任何 ≥1 min 的地面级正提前量;不能给日冕仪那一级一个数。
sim_en: Warning-time account (mars-drill ledger/02_warning.py, 6 gates green): relativistic velocity dispersion on a 2.04 AU Parker line reproduces sci-rad-01 account 5's 17.0/32.2/39.6/117.1 min and the 77.5 min window within 1%; the sentinel's 188/8 s are reproduced only with the background-subtracted difference variance (F-1) r T / sqrt((F+1) r T) = 5, the background-only form gives 62/3 s -- registered so the next reader does not 'correct' the card.
Asymmetric: any ground-level positive lead of 1 min or more is excluded; no number is given for the coronagraph tier.
pois.physics: 到达时间随能量单调递减,大气 20.7 g/cm² 又恰是 166 MeV 的高通滤波器:地面永远最先看见事件、且永远没有对自己剂量的余量——这是恒等式,不是某种谱的巧合。
pois.physics_en: Arrival time falls monotonically with energy, and the 20.7 g/cm2 atmosphere is a high-pass filter at 166 MeV: the surface always sees the event first and never has a margin over its own dose -- an identity, not a property of one spectrum.

pois.label: 疏散看板 · 40.9 分钟,瓶颈是路不是门
pois.label_en: Evacuation board: 40.9 min, and the bottleneck is the road, not the door
pois.detail: 六根条是每分钟的全城位置计数:在岗 / 在途 / 排队 / 闸内 / 轿厢 / 已就位。演习人数 21(地表值班 16 + EVA 3 + 村广场 2,待花名册),按红警即回舱走最近的屏蔽入口:隧道人员气闸(6 m³,3 min 一循环,2 人)、电梯站门斗(同规格)+ 12 人轿厢下 30 m 到玄关。确定性离散事件模拟给出全城清空 40.9 min;最后进门的是发射场的人:穿服 15 + 步行 22.6 + 排队 0 + 气闸 3 + 电梯 0.3 min。预注册押的瓶颈是气闸串行队列,算出来排第三(最长等待 2.5 min)——13 个岗位错峰到达,闸门大半时间空着。
pois.detail_en: The six bars are the city's per-minute location counts: on post / in transit / queued / in the lock / in the cab / sheltered. Drill population 21 (16 surface duty + 3 EVA + 2 on the village plaza; roster pending), 'red means go' to the nearest shielded entrance: the tunnel personnel airlock (6 m3, 3 min per cycle, 2 persons), the lift-station vestibule (same) plus the 12-person cab down 30 m to the foyer. A deterministic discrete-event simulation clears the surface in 40.9 min; the last one in comes from the launch pad: suit-up 15 + walk 22.6 + wait 0 + lock 3 + lift 0.3 min. The pre-registration bet on the airlock's serial queue as the bottleneck; it came third (longest wait 2.5 min) -- thirteen posts arrive staggered and the locks sit idle most of the time.

specs.最后进门: ops-spaceport-01 → 隧道气闸,步行 1.36 km
specs.瓶颈排序(实算): 最远岗位步行 22.6 > 穿服 15 > 气闸最长等待 2.5 min
specs.对表余量: F=10⁴ 的 26.7 min:N≥7 即清不完(穿服 15 时);F=10³ 的 267 min:N=61 也够
specs.杠杆(声明值): 远岗位坐车 5 m/s:穿服 15/5/0 → 31.7/22.3/17.3 min;车辆气闸 8 座 = 24 人/h,永远不是杠杆
specs.电梯满载: 0 趟(6 m³ 门斗每 3 min 只放 2 人,轿厢永远装不满)
specs.花名册配置(ops-roster-01 r1): 66 个地表派班按比例摊到 16 人 → 41.2 min(同头条);花名册无地表值班位置,瞬时人数仍为声明值

specs_en.Bottleneck ranking (measured): farthest walk 22.6 > suit-up 15 > longest airlock wait 2.5 min
specs_en.Personnel lock throughput: 40 persons/h (p=2); lift 0 -> -30 m 62 s per trip = 698/h (17x, not the bottleneck)
specs_en.Against the margin table: F=1e4's 26.7 min: fails from N=7 (suit-up 15); F=1e3's 267 min: N=61 still clears
specs_en.Lever (declared values): rovers at the far posts, 5 m/s: suit-up 15/5/0 -> 31.7/22.3/17.3 min; an 8-seat vehicle through the vehicle gate = 24/h, never the lever
specs_en.Full lift loads: 0 trips (the 6 m3 vestibule meters 2 per 3 min; the cab never fills)
specs_en.Roster placement (ops-roster-01 r1): 66 surface billets spread to 16 -> 41.2 min (same headline); the roster has no surface-duty location, so the instantaneous count stays declared

sim: 疏散容量账(mars-drill ledger/03_evacuation.py,7 闸全绿):守恒(每分钟位置和 = N)、单人极限、解析排队 vs DES 差 ≤1 循环、车辆门 0→8 座消融 <10%、电梯 ≥10× 门斗、物理上限、穿服纯延迟。扫 N=1–61、p=2/3/4、穿服 0/5/15/30、等满发车 0/60/120 s。花名册区间:全在 pwr-grid-01 → 30.7 min;全在发射场 → 49.9 min。
偏出照印:预注册排队第一,实算步行第一;预注册 N≥8 清不完,实算 N≥7;两条都不改预期,改结论。
不能闭合:地下城床位数(ops-roster-01 账 ①)· 地表值班室墙体面密度(各持有者)· 加压乘员车座位数(veh-ground-01)· 穿服时间与步速为声明值。
sim_en: Evacuation account (mars-drill ledger/03_evacuation.py, 7 gates green): conservation, single-person limit, analytic queue vs DES within one cycle, vehicle-gate 0 -> 8 seats ablation < 10%, lift >= 10x vestibule, physical rate cap, suit-up as a pure delay. Scans: N = 1-61, p = 2/3/4, suit-up 0/5/15/30 min, hold-to-fill 0/60/120 s. Roster brackets: everyone at pwr-grid-01 -> 30.7 min; everyone at the launch pad -> 49.9 min.
Misses printed: the prereg ranked the queue first, the run ranks the walk first; the prereg said failure from N >= 8, the run says N >= 7. Neither expectation was edited; the conclusion changed.

Not closable: undercity bed count (ops-roster-01 account 1), wall areal density of surface duty rooms (each holder), pressurised crew-vehicle seats (veh-ground-01); suit-up time and walking speed are declared.
pois.physics: 一座 6 m³ 气闸 3 分钟一循环是抽气泵与回收率定的,不是门的问题;它把人流切成 2 人/3 min 的脉冲,下游 12 人轿厢因此永远吃不饱——容量在链上最小的一环,而这一环在本城并不排队,因为人根本没同时到。
pois.physics_en: A 6 m3 airlock's 3-minute cycle is set by the pump and the recovery fraction, not by the door; it chops the flow into 2-person pulses every 3 min, so the 12-person cab downstream never fills. Capacity is the smallest link in the chain -- and in this city that link does not even queue, because people do not arrive together.

pois.label: 警笛 · 这场事件在本城判据下不会响
pois.label_en: The siren: the measured event would not ring it
pois.detail: 演习输入是 RAD 在火星地表实测过的最大一次 SEP:2017-09-10 19:50 UT 起、次日上午到峰、平台约 10 h、事件总吸收剂量 418 µGy(Si)、峰值剂量率为 GCR 本底的 2–3 倍(Zeitlin、Ehresmann、Hassler 2018)。地表站数的是穿透 >166 MeV 的粒子,这场事件 >135 MeV 质子峰值 ×4——计数峰倍数在 2–4 之间:红警(30×)被排除,黄警(3×)不能确立。所以演习的 t=0 红警是演习注入,不是这场事件在本城规则下自然产生的。剂量率曲线的形状是声明参数(逐时 RAD 表不在手),两个文献积分是闸。
pois.detail_en: The drill's input is the largest SEP that RAD has measured on the Martian surface: onset 2017-09-10 19:50 UT, peak the next morning, a ~10 h plateau, event-integrated absorbed dose 418 uGy (Si), peak dose rate 2-3x the GCR background (Zeitlin, Ehresmann, Hassler 2018). The surface station counts penetrating particles above 166 MeV; this event raised >135 MeV protons by up to 4x -- a count peak factor between 2 and 4: red (30x) is excluded, yellow (3x) is not established. So the drill's t = 0 red is an exercise injection, not something this event would produce under the city's own rule. The curve's shape is a declared parameter (the hourly RAD table is not in hand); the two literature integrals are the gates.

specs.平台 / 衰减: 12 h 爬升(声明)+ 10 h 平台(文献)+ τ_d 31.8 / 7.9 h(由 418 反解)

specs_en.Plateau / decay: 12 h rise (declared) + 10 h plateau (literature) + tau_d 31.8 / 7.9 h (solved from 418)

sim: 事件账(mars-drill ledger/01_event.py,7 闸全绿):∫超额 = 418 ±0.5%(闭式 vs 梯形 <0.1%)、峰倍数 ∈[2,3]、超额→0 退化到 0.2158 mGy/sol、单位链、爬升 2–14 h 消融总量不变。预注册 E1.2 偏出:有效时长 47.8 h(预期 20–40)——预注册那行用了 0.25 mGy/day 本底而 E1.1 用 0.21;E1.3 偏出 0.2 µGy/h。
预注册在读到 Ehresmann 摘要之前声明了 2 h 爬升;摘要给出「次日上午到峰 + 10 h 平台」,基线改用文献形状,2 h 保留为消融——首小时的避难剂量对形状敏感 6×,账 ④ 两案并印。
sim_en: Event account (mars-drill ledger/01_event.py, 7 gates green): integral of the excess = 418 +-0.5% (closed form vs trapezoid < 0.1%), peak factor in [2, 3], excess -> 0 degenerates to 0.2158 mGy/sol, unit chain, rise 2-14 h ablation leaves the total unchanged. Prereg E1.2 missed: effective duration 47.8 h (expected 20-40) -- that prereg line used a 0.25 mGy/day baseline while E1.1 used 0.21; E1.3 missed by 0.2 uGy/h.

The prereg declared a 2 h rise before the Ehresmann abstract was read; the abstract gives 'peak the next morning + 10 h plateau', so the base case uses the literature shape and 2 h is kept as the ablation -- the first-hour sheltered dose is 6x shape-sensitive, account 4 prints both.
pois.physics: 大气把 <166 MeV 全吃掉,地表只看见事件的硬尾;2017 事件 <100 MeV 质子 ×30 而 >135 MeV 只 ×4——同一场耀斑在轨道上是大事、在 Jezero 地面是计数器上一次没过阈的抬头。
pois.physics_en: The atmosphere removes everything below 166 MeV, so the surface sees only the hard tail: the 2017 event raised <100 MeV protons 30x but >135 MeV only 4x -- the same flare is a major event in orbit and a sub-threshold bump on the Jezero counter.

pois.label: 规程牌 · 难的是待在下面,不是跑下去
pois.label_en: Rule plaque: the hard part is staying down, not running down
pois.detail: 避难剂量账只引已裁定数。地表露天:平静 0.21 mGy/day / 0.66 mSv/sol(RAD)+ 事件曲线;村子床位:Run B 地板 27.0 mSv/yr(GCR),覆土 330 g/cm² 停住 <~1 GeV 的一次质子,SEP 削减本身不能闭合(只给上界 48 µGy);玄关与居住区(30 m 岩):哨兵柱对 F=2–10⁴ 读数变化 <1% → SEP 增量 ≤4 µGy;深地:0。按演习的就位时刻积分,最后进门的人(41 min 在地表)只多吃 0.2–0.3 µGy——事件总量的千分之一;418 µGy 的 90% 在起始后 32–82 h 才送达。对 RAD 级事件,撤得快慢不改剂量,改剂量的是在下面待多久。对 1972 级(F=10⁴,引 sci-rad-01 表 44.9 mSv/h):41 min 的地表停留 = 30.6 mSv,超职业年限。
pois.detail_en: The shelter-dose account cites only ruled numbers. Open surface: quiet 0.21 mGy/day / 0.66 mSv/sol (RAD) plus the event curve; village bunk: Run B floor 27.0 mSv/yr (GCR), 330 g/cm2 of cover stops primary protons below ~1 GeV, the SEP reduction itself is not closable (upper bound only: 48 uGy); foyer and quarters (30 m rock): the sentinel columns change < 1% for F = 2 to 1e4, so the SEP increment is <= 4 uGy; deep lab: 0. Integrated to each person's sheltering time, the last one in (41 min on the surface) receives 0.2-0.3 uGy extra -- a thousandth of the event; 90% of the 418 uGy arrives 32-82 h after onset. For a RAD-class event, how fast you get down does not change the dose; how long you stay down does. For a 1972-class event (F = 1e4, sci-rad-01's cited 44.9 mSv/h), 41 min on the surface is 30.6 mSv, past the occupational annual limit.

specs.最后进门者多吃: 0.2 / 0.3 µGy(峰 2× / 3×,文献形状);2 h 爬升形状 1.0 / 2.0 µGy
specs.村子床位 SEP 上界: ≤48 µGy/事件(若覆土对 SEP 只做到对 GCR 的 8.7×)

specs_en.Last person's extra: 0.2 / 0.3 uGy (peak 2x / 3x, literature shape); 2 h-rise shape 1.0 / 2.0 uGy
specs_en.Village bunk SEP bound: <= 48 uGy per event (if the cover only did for SEP what it does for GCR, 8.7x)

sim: 避难剂量账(mars-drill ledger/04_shelter_dose.py,5 闸全绿):可加性(Σ人 停留加权剂量 = ∫D·N_surface dt,<1e-4)、极限 0/418、单位链、已知答案 Q、村子倍数消融不改结论。预注册 E4.1 偏出:预期 5–20 µGy,算得 0.2–0.3(文献形状把峰推到 12 h 后);「撤得快慢不改剂量」在两种形状下都成立。
不能闭合:村子覆土对 SEP 谱的削减(res-glass-01 Geant4 一个 SEP 谱 run 即可)· 地表值班室墙体 · Si→组织与 Q 只扫描(1.0–1.3 × 1.0–1.5)不取点。
sim_en: Shelter-dose account (mars-drill ledger/04_shelter_dose.py, 5 gates green): additivity (sum over persons of stay-weighted dose = integral of D x N_surface dt, < 1e-4), limits 0/418, unit chain, known-answer Q, village-factor ablation leaves the verdict. Prereg E4.1 missed: expected 5-20 uGy, got 0.2-0.3 (the literature shape puts the peak 12 h out); 'speed does not change the dose' holds under both shapes.

Not closable: the village cover's reduction of an SEP spectrum (one Geant4 run at res-glass-01 would close it), surface duty-room walls, Si -> tissue and Q scanned only (1.0-1.3 x 1.0-1.5), no point value.
pois.physics: 剂量是速率对时间的积分;一场以小时计的事件里,几十分钟的奔跑只占积分的千分之一,而屏蔽体外的每一个小时都是同样的一份。于是规程的重点从「多快到」换成「多久不出来」——解除条件归 sci-rad-01 的 <3× 判据,本册不替它写。
pois.physics_en: Dose is the time integral of a rate; in an event measured in hours, a run of tens of minutes is a thousandth of the integral, while every hour outside the shielding is a full share. The rule therefore shifts from 'how fast you arrive' to 'how long before you come out' -- the all-clear belongs to sci-rad-01's < 3x criterion, not to this ledger.

pois.label: 响应钩子 · userData.alarm
pois.detail: 这台控制台是钩子的参考实现:build() 在 group.userData.alarm 上声明 {levels, level, set(level, frame, ctx)};set() 只改自己的三色灯与看板(告警灯不进 blinkMats / nightMats,那两条是引擎每帧接管的通道),幂等且可回退。没有引擎播放器时,「演习开始」按钮置标志,animate 用由 drill.json 生成的内嵌摘要以 60× 压缩自演一遍(1 真实分钟 = 1 秒),同文件优雅降级;引擎播放器就绪后由总控接到 __mars.drill。drill.json 的 units[] 每单位只在字段变化时出关键帧,flow[] 每分钟一行全城位置计数,paths[] 每人一条路径供人流动画。
pois.detail_en: This console is the reference implementation of the hook: build() declares {levels, level, set(level, frame, ctx)} on group.userData.alarm; set() changes only its own lamps and board (alarm lamps stay out of blinkMats / nightMats, the two channels the engine drives every frame), idempotent and reversible. Without an engine player, the 'start drill' action sets a flag and animate replays the embedded summary generated from drill.json at 60x compression (one real minute per second), degrading gracefully in the same file; once the engine player exists the integrator wires __mars.drill to it. drill.json emits a keyframe per unit only when a field changes, a per-minute city-wide location count in flow[], and one path per person in paths[] for the flow animation.

specs.数据: drill.json(schema drill.schema.json;27 单位关键帧,47 分钟,21 条路径)
specs.引擎侧待接: setAlarm(level, source) · __mars.drill 播放器 · 人流小件(总控)

specs_en.Data: drill.json (schema drill.schema.json; 27 units with keyframes, 47 minutes, 21 paths)
specs_en.Compression: 60x (printed on the plaque, not passed off as real time)
specs_en.Engine side pending: setAlarm(level, source), the __mars.drill player, the flow figures (integrator)

sim: 演习编排账(mars-drill ledger/05_drill.py,6 闸全绿):schema 校验、每分钟守恒、路径连续无跳变、T_clear 与账 ③ 同一数、两次生成 sha256 相同、sci-rad-03/04 行全程恒等(已知答案)。预注册 E5.2 偏出:有关键帧的单位 27(预期 14–18,因为 13 个地表值班资产各占一行);E5.3 偏出:电梯满载 0 趟(预注册已写明可能)。
通风切换登记为门斗关闭后的域封闭动作,不是辐射学动作——SEP 不随空气进舱。
sim_en: Drill account (mars-drill ledger/05_drill.py, 6 gates green): schema validation, per-minute conservation, contiguous paths, T_clear byte-equal to account 3, two generations give the same sha256, sci-rad-03/04 rows constant throughout (known answer). Prereg E5.2 missed: 27 units carry keyframes (expected 14-18, because the 13 surface duty units each take a row); E5.3 missed: 0 full lift loads (the prereg had named this as possible).
The ventilation switch is logged as a domain-seal action after the doors close, not a radiological one -- an SEP does not travel with the air.
pois.physics: 钩子把「灯归单位、时钟归引擎」分开:引擎只广播等级与计数,每个单位用自己的几何回答「红警时我做什么」。这和感知通道(sensors)是同一条设计律——资产永远不直接碰 renderer,也永远不替别的资产改灯。
pois.physics_en: The hook separates 'lamps belong to the unit, the clock belongs to the engine': the engine broadcasts only a level and counts, and each unit answers 'what do I do on red' with its own geometry. It is the same design law as the sensor channel -- an asset never touches the renderer, and never changes another asset's lamps.
